overview_description.description: Eco is the stablecoin network that makes money programmable across every major blockchain, including Ethereum and Solana. Leading companies use Eco to move stablecoins such as USDC and USDT with a seamless user experience and best-in-class execution: cross-chain transfers and swaps, programmable payment flows, and more complex automations. Eco Routes provides a permissionless, cross-chain stablecoin liquidity layer, and Eco Accounts give users unified balances and one-click actions across chains. Money simply moves smarter with Eco.

about_short_description.short_description: Eco is the stablecoin network that makes money programmable across every major blockchain.

product.name: Eco Routes
product.description: A permissionless, cross-chain stablecoin liquidity layer enabling apps to transfer stablecoins across multiple Ethereum-based chains with flexible options for speed, cost, and security.

product.name: Eco Accounts
product.description: A system enabling unified stablecoin balances and one-click cross-chain actions by aggregating user stablecoin holdings across multiple wallets and chains.

product.name: Eco Crowd Liquidity
product.description: A platform that aggregates passive stablecoin liquidity from users to increase network capacity and provide yield by allocating capital to cross-chain stablecoin transactions.

product.name: Eco Portal
product.description: A user interface powered by Eco Routes that allows anyone to transfer stablecoins instantly and cheaply across multiple Ethereum-based chains.

product.name: Eco Protocol
product.description: An Ethereum-based rollup and permissionless liquidity network optimized for capital-efficient stablecoin transaction execution and cross-chain stablecoin transfers.
